_comment: Map Phase 3.5 proof A: the ~1 km² FMG-compiled world (maps/fmg-1km.worldmap.json, extent 1000×1000 m) over the MAIN ISLAND — every visible tile is CLIENT-streamed around the live camera (world.setTerrainSource only; no generateRegion). The world.streamFollow command carries no valid regionId (this world never generated a region) so the skill call is an isolated authoring failure — it is here ONLY so runLive's client-stream radius picker (browser-entry.ts) reads radius:14, the Phase-3.5 cap. Expect: the central island (mountain core, grass/forest paint, river channels) with the two enrichment islets' water between, coastline falling to the sea floor, distance fading into sky-matched haze.
